subject: Hosted API: tiered retainer & baseline spend — CloudScale inquiry
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@cloudscale.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API baseline / retainer options

Hi Karthik,

Quick question from our procurement team as we evaluate Redwood for a generative search pilot: do you have a documented set of hosted‑API retainer/commit tiers or a minimum monthly spend for paying customers?

We don't want Dedicated yet — we're starting with hosted — but procurement needs to understand whether there is a mandatory baseline (e.g., $X/month) to unlock discounts or an SLA. Our expected initial usage is small (roughly 500k tokens/month) but could double if the pilot results are positive.

Can you: 
- Share the published rate card or a summary of baseline/retainer tiers?
- Clarify whether we can do a short pilot without committing to monthly minimums and still get trial credits or discounted rates?

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Data Products, CloudScale Inc
emma@cloudscale.com


From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@cloudscale.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline / retainer options

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the context. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we have published per‑token rates for the hosted API, and we offer tiered retainer/commit bands for customers who want predictable unit economics and SLAs.
- You can absolutely run a short pilot on the hosted API without a long‑term commit; we commonly offer pilot credits and time‑boxed trials.

I'll loop in Aditya (sales engineer) and Laura (pricing) to share the specific rate card and suggest a pilot approach that fits your usage profile. Could you share the target latency and whether you need encryption/KMS for this pilot? That will affect the recommended model family and potentially the rate.

Propose: I'll send a brief rate card PDF and a two‑week pilot SOW draft with a recommended baseline (and an option to convert to a 3‑ or 12‑month retainer) — low lift to get you started.

Would Tue or Wed next week be a good time for a 30‑minute sync?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555‑0192

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API baseline / retainer options — CloudScale (context + ask)

Forwarding CloudScale's ask — initial usage ~500k tokens/mo, likely burst to ~1M if pilot goes well. They're hosted only for now; procurement wants to know:

- Published retainer/commit bands and the minimum monthly spend that triggers an SLA.
- What's typical for a small startup that wants a short pilot but prefers predictable pricing if they convert.

Aditya — can you recommend the model family and an expected cost estimate for 500k and 1M tokens, and call out whether prefix caching or batching could materially lower costs?

Laura — can you share a 'pilot-friendly' rate card excerpt (PDF) and a suggested minimum that would be reasonable for a 3‑month retainer vs. a pilot? Ideally something we can hand to procurement.

Thanks — I told them we'd send a short PDF + pilot SOW.

Karthik

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API baseline / retainer options — CloudScale (rate card + pilot)

Karthik / Aditya — attaching a concise rate card excerpt and a short pilot SOW to share with CloudScale. Highlights below (short summary for procurement):

- Published hosted API (on‑demand) rates: see PDF. Typical per‑token rates vary by model family; baseline (gpt‑like small) around $0.0008/token for generation on on‑demand, embeddings separate.

- Retainer/commit bands (hosted):
  • Starter retainer — $5,000/mo commit: 10% discount vs on‑demand, 99.5% uptime SLA, 30‑day notice
  • Growth retainer — $20,000/mo commit: 20% discount, 99.9% SLA, dedicated capacity scheduling priority
  • Enterprise retainer — custom pricing and SLAs (requires sales/CS engagement)

- Pilot guidance:
  • We commonly run a 2–4 week hosted pilot with no long‑term commit.
  • Offer: $1,000 pilot credit plus a temporary 8% pilot discount on usage during the trial.
  • If they convert to a Starter retainer within 30 days of pilot end, we can apply an additional one‑time credit equal to 10% of their pilot month spend.

- Notes on viability for CloudScale's numbers: 500k tokens/month at a small model family would be well below the Starter retainer; if they expect to spike to ~1M tokens, that's still within Starter. If they want the 99.9% SLA, they'd need Growth or an explicit SLA add‑on.

Attached files (simple stubs):
- Redwood_Rate_Card_May2026.pdf (one‑page excerpt)
- CloudScale_Pilot_SOW_v1.docx (2‑week pilot scope, acceptance criteria, pilot credit details)

Let me know if you want different wording for procurement. I recommend proposing the 2‑week pilot + $1k credit and offering Starter retainer as the conservative conversion path.

Laura Bennett
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@cloudscale.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@cloudscale.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline / retainer options

Emma / Ben — thanks again for the context and patience while we pulled this together. Attached are two short files: the one‑page rate card excerpt and a draft 2‑week pilot SOW. Quick summary tailored for Procurement:

- Pilot option (recommended): 2‑week hosted pilot, no long‑term commit required. Pilot includes $1,000 usage credit + an 8% usage discount during the pilot period.
- Conversion path: Starter retainer is $5,000/month (10% discount, 99.5% uptime SLA). Given your current run‑rate (500k tokens/mo) Starter is the conservative next step if you want predictable pricing and basic SLA.
- If you expect to require SLA parity with production, consider Growth retainer ($20k/mo) for 99.9% SLA and priority scheduling.

Next steps:
1) If you want the pilot, reply and we'll kick off with the SOW and activate credits.
2) If procurement prefers a 3‑month trial with a small committed minimum, we can draft a 3‑month Starter retainer with a 5% additional conversion credit.

Cc'd Laura for any questions on wording/terms; Aditya can set up a quick technical sync to finalize model selection and expected latency.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555‑0192

Attachments: Redwood_Rate_Card_May2026.pdf (PDF stub), CloudScale_Pilot_SOW_v1.docx (DOCX stub)
